g.text: (a) Heliocentric Keplerian orbits of Earth and Mars (J2000 elements, coplanar approximation); shading where Mars is within 3° of the Sun. (b) Approximate times
available before harm, compared with a ground loop of two light-times plus 30 minutes for experts to respond. Red: crew must act alone; amber: ground advice arrives
